Youssouf était le premier à arrive, finalement je suis aussi arrivé. Yuusufi was the first to arrive, finally I arrived. Suudu Haaruuna artoriimi, sakitii ngarumi ɗo. suusude   Noun Form of Infinitive: suusugol. Participles: sing: cuusuɗo plur: suusuɓe. Sorting Designation: 2. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: s/c. Verb Stative or Progressive: st. suusuu   Noun Class Markers: sing: o. Sorting Designation: 4. Noun. une très légère pluie; sprinkle of rain; misting of rain. Catégorie : Temps. ***: nyeko, sooso, miso; compare: ƴuwoonde; synonyms: miso, nyeko, sooso. Dialects: J,Y,M.

suutinaade   Noun Form of Infinitive: suutinagol. Participles: sing: suutiniiɗo-suutinotooɗo plur: suutiniiɓe-suutinotooɓe. Sorting Designation: 4. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: s/c. Verb Stative or Progressive: st/prg. Verb. regarder fixement; stare. ***: futtinde, ƴeppitaade; compare: ɗuurtaade; synonyms: futtinde, ƴeppitaade. Dialects: Y,G.

suuttude   Noun Form of Infinitive: suurtugol. Participles: sing: cuurtuɗo-cuurtoowo plur: suurtuɓe-suurtooɓe. Sorting Designation: 3, th. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: s/c. Verb Stative or Progressive: prg. Verb. 1 • révéler qqch qui était cachée, exposer des torts; expose wrong doings whether yours or someone else's; reveal that which is hidden. O suuttii ko o suuɗunoo ley suudu. Il a révélé / exposé ce qu'il avait caché dans la maison. He revealed what he had hidden in the house. ***: suuritinde, wanginde, funcitinde, udditinde; synonyms: funcitinde, suuritinde, udditinde. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

2 • confesser ses péchés; confess one's sins. O suuttii junuubaaji makko fuu yeeso Laamɗo. Il a confessé devant Dieu tous ses péchés. He confessed all his sins before God. synonyms: tuubande; compare: curki, haƴƴe, junuuba, wulude, yiite. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

suuwtude   Noun Form of Infinitive: suuwtugol. Participles: sing: cuuwtuɗo-cuuwtotoowo plur: suuwtuɓe-suuwtotooɓe. Sorting Designation: 4, ct. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: s/c. Verb Stative or Progressive: prg. Verb. 1 • vite enlever qqch de l'eau bouillante ou du feu; quickly remove something from either boiling water or the fire. Suuwtu ɓoccooɗe jaawle ɗe e ley ngulɗam. Enlève les œufs de pintade de l'eau chaude. Remove the guinea hen eggs from the hot water. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

2 • enlever qqch d'un puits ou d'un trou profond; get something out of a well or deep hole. War, cuuwten ɓii nagge ley ɓunndu ga. Viens, on va enlever le veau du puits. Come, let us remove the calf from this well. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

3 • enlever un chiot ou un chaton d'un trou et l'amener à la maison; to bring a puppy home or kitten home - they say this because often here dogs give birth to their puppies in a hole; so to take one you have to reach into a hole and pull it out! Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

suuwude   Noun Form of Infinitive: suuwugol. Participles: sing: cuuwuɗo-cuuwoowo plur: suuwuɓe-suuwooɓe. Sorting Designation: 3. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: s/c. Verb Stative or Progressive: prg. Verb. 1 • tremper, plonger; dip. Mi suuwan hoy si hamaama. Je trempe mon doigt dans la sauce lorsqu'elle est cuite. I will dip my finger in the sauce when it is prepared.; fig. to dip into your work; Hannden mi suuwii ndemri. Aujourd'hui je commencerai mon sarclage. Today I will start my hoeing. ***: noonude. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

2 • teindre; dye. synonyms: noonude; compare: ɓawlinde, boodude, oolɗinde, rawninde, wojjinde, ƴakkinde. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

suuy(u)de   Noun Form of Infinitive: suuy(u)gol. Participles: sing: cuuyɗo plur: suuyɓe. Sorting Designation: 2. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: s/c. Verb Stative or Progressive: st. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

suuyde   Noun Class Markers: sing: nde. Sorting Designation: 4. Noun. bravoure, courage; bravery; courage. ***: gorgu, suusude, ngorgu1, feeteende, cuusal, suuy(u)de; synonyms: cuusal, feeteende, gorgu, ngorgu1. Dialects: J.

suwtaade   Noun Form of Infinitive: suwtagol. Participles: sing: cuwtiiɗo-cuwtotooɗo plur: suwtiiɓe-suwtotooɓe. Sorting Designation: 3. Verb Consonant Change in Plural: s/c. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

2 • se lever en sautant, sauter sur les pieds lors d'une surprise; jump when startled; jump up from a sitting position. compare: dillude, hootude. Dialectal Forms: note some speakers will say suhutaade. Dialects: J,Y,G,M.

suyre   Noun Class Markers: sing: nde. Plural Form of Noun: huyre. Sorting Designation: 3, dh. Noun. 1 • muscle, un muscle étiré, courbature de muscle, déchirure musculaire; muscle; a pulled muscle in the upper body. Catégorie : Le corps. ***: adala. Dialects: J.

2 • muscle qui fait mal au coup ou thorax; sore muscle in the neck and thorax area only. Catégorie : Maladie. Dialects: J,Y.
